source:
Can be engraved on Manastone slots in all weapons and armor to imbue them with stats.
The type and value of the stats are determined by chance.
translation:
Można go wygrawerować w gniazdach kamieni many na wszystkich broniach i zbrojach, aby nadać im statystyki.
Rodzaj i wartość statystyk są losowe.

source: Obtained when extracting Arcana. Used as a material for Arcana synthesis.

source: A Talisman condensed with AION's memorie. Use to reach Level 45.
